summary: Frontend-only refactor test of /justicesquare. Feeds JSON endpoint returns 200 and drives the page dynamically. All required data-testid elements render, filters work, external links are deep and target=_blank, no EGMR filter exists in Reports, Infographics heading is exact, and mobile viewport renders single-column without React crash. No JusticeSquare-specific issues found; only pre-existing unrelated console warnings noted (CSP/Cloudflare, Vite HMR, Firebase placeholder, Turnstile) — all acknowledged and ignored per request.
critical_code_review_comments: JusticeSquarePage.tsx is ~600 lines; consider splitting each section (News/Reports/Infographics/Multimedia/UsefulLinks) into subcomponents for maintainability.
The setChartKey initial value is derived from feeds state at first render; the useEffect fallback correctly handles feed updates — OK.

News item 'news-ecthr-yalcinkaya' (category Gerichtsurteil) has source 'European Court of Human Rights (EGMR)' — this appears only under News (allowed), and NOT under Reports institutions (verified). Consistent with the spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright against the external preview URL. Key checks: feeds JSON 200, hero (h1 + 3 stats + 4 nav), 4 last-updated badges, 5 news cards with deep external links and target=_blank, news filter Gerichtsurteil yields 1 result, 11 reports with 11 institution filters (no EGMR), report filter narrows to 1 for Turkey Rights Monitor, Infographics heading exactly 'Interaktive Infografiken & Statistiken' with 4 tabs and chart switch works, 4 multimedia cards as external links, 15 useful-link buttons, editorial guideline mentions wöchentlich/monatlich, mobile 390px renders single column.
